notes: Focused Java public-API evidence for IEEE 1516.1-2025 §12.12.4.2. The basic-data-elements scenario checks standard encoded bytes, decoded values, and malformed-input rejection through the Java DataElement API across the standard integer, floating-point, boolean, octet, ASCII, Unicode, octet-pair, and opaque-data helpers. The HLAopaqueData Table 27 cell has no individual immutable helper requirement candidate and receives no cell-level mapping here. C++ external pointer/storage and clone semantics are not asserted for Java; this evidence is not exhaustive Annex C coverage or conformance.
